messages:
tayla.p: FYI: on Sun 00:00–01:30 UTC were migrating CI auth from per-repo PATs/Okta apps to the Identity Gateway (idp-proxy). This removes long-lived tokens from repos. Migration doc: https://docs.internal/idp-proxy/ci-rollover

mira.s: Who needs to act? quick checklist please.

tayla.p: TL;DR:
- Devs: remove any hardcoded PATs and run jobs in `redwood-ci-staging` with CI_IDP_TEST=true
- Runner owners: install runner-agent >=0.9.2
- Repo admins: review service-account mappings in the doc

chris.infra: Will self-hosted runners still use node creds?

tayla.p: They call idp-proxy for short-lived tokens; remove org-level PATs from runner config. Weve got an automated cleanup script in the repo.

oliver.sre: Rollback plan?

tayla.p: We have a 30m Okta passthrough fallback. Runbook in doc includes `kubectl` commands to re-enable the old route.

deploy-bot: Canary sequence: 5% -> 25% -> 100% if health checks pass. Alerts: pager for P1.

mira.s: I'll run readiness checks Fri 14:00 UTC. Ping me if you hit blockers.

tayla.p: Thanks — please post issues here and tag @chris.infra or @oliver.sre. :thumbsup:
